(01) In perspective

That is not a typo. Twelve private clubs sit on three square miles of the most valuable land in America and pay, all together, about a quarter of what the Century City mall pays on 42 acres. Public access: members and their guests. 1,896 acres is a lot of acres.

(02) The numbers

Same tax rate, same neighborhood.

Three properties in tax rate area 00067, all taxed at 1.18738 percent, from the FY 2025-26 roll as reported by The Basin.

Three ways a club parcel tax could reach voters

This site is not a campaign for any particular measure. It explains the idea of a parcel tax on private clubs.

(05) A parcel tax, explained

$4 / sq ft

A flat charge per square foot of land each year, on top of the regular property tax. It does not change how the county assesses the land.
